blocks.text: This route takes you through Mountain Pine Ridge, Maya archaeological sites, Barton Creek Cave, Ambergris Caye and Belize City. Over six days, you’ll visit Caracol and the Caana pyramid, canoe along an underground river, take a water taxi to San Pedro and explore Hol Chan Marine Reserve.
